ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle $ABCD$, $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$, and $E$ and $F$ are the midpoints of $AO$ and $AD$ respectively. If $EF=4$ and $AB=8$, what is the measure of $\angle ACB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that E and F are the midpoints of AO and AD respectively,\\
it follows that EF is the midline of $\triangle AOD$,\\
hence OD = 2EF = $2\times 4$ = 8,\\
since quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it implies OB = OD = OA = OC = 8,\\
which means AC = 16,\\
given AB = 8,\\
it follows AC = 2AB,\\
since $\angle$ABC = 90$^\circ$,\\
it results in $\angle$ACB = \boxed{30^\circ}.
